# Blanc Engine

> Blanc Engine is an open-source, no-code visual novel desktop creation suite and standalone runtime for Windows. It lets creators write stories like screenplays, design character sprites and menus visually, and export ready-to-play Windows games (Setup installer and portable executable) with zero coding required.

## Key Features
- Visual Story Flow Node Graph: Interactive screenplay flowchart to branch dialogue, choices, variables, and conditions.
- Live-Preview UI Designer: Visual WYSIWYG menu, textbox, and layout editor.
- Character and Asset Manager: Built-in sprite expressions, background, and audio management.
- Multi-Language CSV Localization: Easy string extraction and multi-language translation support.
- Zero-Code Windows Export: Instant packaging into standalone Windows games (Setup.exe and Portable .zip).
- Free and Open Source: Licensed under GNU GPL v3.
